text:
Anya (Partnerships): quick heads-up — we need a contingency for the marketplace catalog soft-open. press embargo is tight but a hardware SI cert might slip. want a standby plan for landing + press hold?
Dylan (Marketing): +1. can we have a "soft-open" landing that doesn't trigger press (no hero banner, no announcement)?
Carla (Product): yep. simplest approach: feature flag hero=false, enable partner onboarding flows behind a gated URL. keeps early partners moving.
Anya (Partnerships): proposed steps: 1) partner-only landing URL, 2) hero behind feature flag for full announce, 3) SI standby flip once cert is green.
Ravi (SI Lead): we'll expose /si-onboard/{tenant}. SI ops needs a short handoff runbook. 2-3h per tenant to wire and verify.
Sanjay (Platform): infra can route staging -> /si-onboard/* with cache-control: noindex and robots meta. low-effort. I can deploy the route today.
Dylan (Marketing): draft copy for soft-open: "Partner portal — Early onboarding access." neutral and embargo-safe.
Michael (Legal): that phrasing is fine; avoid product claims or metrics until embargo lifts.
Anya (Partnerships): adding a compact checklist and tagging ops-bot to record deploy / PRs.
ops-bot: deployment queued: staging -> /si-onboard route; ETA 18m. details: https://deploys.redwood.example/1789
Carla (Product): SI handoff runbook snippet:
- Create tenant in staging
- Assign SI onboarding URL /si-onboard/{tenant}
- Share ephemeral creds + partner checklist with Ravi
- Ensure model routing + billing flags = partner-tier
- Smoke: generate chat -> verify latency < 600ms and policy checks pass
Ravi (SI Lead): adding fallback: if hardware cert fails last-minute, flip hero to a "Request early access" form (no press). captures interest without public announce.
Dylan (Marketing): use existing form: https://redwood.example/early-access — good fallback for list capture.
Anya (Partnerships): owners: Sanjay = infra toggle, Ravi = SI handoff, Dylan = soft-copy + form, Michael = legal sign-off, Carla = QA smoke. I'll own final go/no-go. deadline: EOD tomorrow.
Sanjay (Platform): noted. will post when route is live.
ops-bot: route /si-onboard/* is now live on staging — deployment 1789 succeeded.
Anya (Partnerships): great. Ravi, please onboard tenant "alpha" tonight and report smoke here.
Ravi (SI Lead): will do, reporting back by 22:00 PT with logs and any issues.
Dylan (Marketing): I'll drop minimal partner-facing copy into #marketing-review in 30m.
Michael (Legal): I'll check copy by noon tomorrow.
Carla (Product): will run latency and billing smoke after Ravi confirms.
Anya (Partnerships): thanks all — fallback path looks good. re-open thread if anything changes.
